gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Gliosarcoma; GBM; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype; Recurrent Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: In phase 2, patients will receive carboplatin immediately prior to sonication using the SC9 device and microbubbles in order to open the blood-brain barrier
open the BBB immediately prior to chemotherapy infusion with albumin-bound paclitaxel

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Radiographic evidence of tumor recurrence/progression after failure of 1 - 2 lines of prior therapy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: tissue concentrations in different parts of the resected tumor will be measured
to demonstrate that the opening of the BBB increases chemotherapy concentration in the tumor

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Measurement of circulating tumor DNA, methods and units for this measure are to be determined and still under evaluation.: compare before and after sonication

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Chemotherapy, albumin-bound paclitaxel (other names: Abraxane®, ABX): Intravenous infusion of ABX over 30 minutes
carboplatin will be added to the regimen and additional patients will be treated in order to better evaluate the antitumor efficacy of this novel treatment
[DRUG] Chemotherapy, carboplatin (other names: Paraplatin): Intravenous infusion of carboplatin over 30 minutes
Definity® (the FDA-approved ultrasound contrast agent to be used in this study)
repeat activation of 9 ultrasound emitters during i.v. injection of microbubbles

agents.drug_class_hint: ultrasound contrast microbubbles used for BBB opening

source_quote.quote: Confirmed diagnosis of Isocitrate Dehydrogenase 1 (IDH1) wild-type glioblastoma on pathology from initial surgery
Measurement of circulating tumor DNA, methods and units for this measure are to be determined and still under evaluation.

coder_notes: Single-arm phase 1/2: implantable ultrasound (SonoCloud-9) BBB opening with nab-paclitaxel, carboplatin added in phase 2. Both chemotherapies paired with device-enabled delivery (device_dependent). Definity microbubbles are not a registered intervention but are stated as used in the study; listed as delivery-enabling. Phase 2 outcome 'SSR3' is not defined in the record and not coded as a biomarker.
